quests.name: One Draenei's Junk...
quests.description: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.

quests.name: Betrayed
quests.description: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.

quests.name: Betrayed
quests.description: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

quests.name: Betrayed

quests.name: Breaking the Ward
quests.description: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.description: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.description: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

quests.name: The Name of the Beast
quests.description: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

quests.name: In Eranikus' Own Words
quests.description: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.

quests.name: The Runed Scroll
quests.description: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

quests.name: Horde Presence
quests.description: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

quests.name: Stealing Knowledge
quests.description: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Delivery to Magatha
quests.description: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.description: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs. Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

quests.name: Seeping Corruption

quests.name: Kim'jael Indeed!
quests.description: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.

quests.name: Azsharite
quests.description: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits. Return to Loramus when the task is complete.

quests.name: The Formation of Felbane
quests.description: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry

quests.name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
quests.description: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj. Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

quests.name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
quests.description: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.

quests.description: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.

quests.name: Dreadmaul Rock
quests.description: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

quests.name: Krom'Grul
quests.description: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.

quests.name: Extinguish the Firegut
quests.description: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.

quests.name: Gor'tesh the Brute Lord
quests.description: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
quests.description: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.

quests.description: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A Short Incubation
quests.description: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.description: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

quests.description: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.

quests.description: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.

quests.name: Expedition Salvation
quests.description: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Roll the Bones
quests.description: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Alien Ecology
quests.description: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns. Bring the Hive Wall Sample to Hol'anyee Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Williden's Journal
quests.description: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
quests.description: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.

quests.name: Scavenging Deathknell
quests.description: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.

quests.name: Milly Osworth
quests.description: Speak with Milly Osworth.

quests.name: Milly's Harvest
quests.description: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Grape Manifest
quests.description: Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.description: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
quests.description: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

quests.name: It's a Secret to Everybody
quests.description: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: The Videre Elixir
quests.description: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Meet at the Grave
quests.description: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

quests.name: A Grave Situation
quests.description: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

quests.name: Linken's Sword
quests.description: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Wenikee Boltbucket

quests.name: Nugget Slugs

quests.description: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A Gnome's Assistance
quests.description: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Linken's Memory
quests.description: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Linken's Adventure
quests.description: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
quests.description: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge. Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.description: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.description: Defend Gor'shak.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.description: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar. You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdom
quests.description: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.description: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

quests.name: The Princess Saved?
quests.description: Return to Thrall!

quests.name: Aquementas
quests.description: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris. Use the Book of Aquor to summon Aquementas. After you have the completed totem, take it to J.D. Collie in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Counterattack!

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.description: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.description: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth. You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.description: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.description: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus. You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.description: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
quests.description: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
quests.description: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

quests.name: Silver Heart
quests.description: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.description: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.

quests.name: Cleansing Felwood
quests.description: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.

quests.name: The Strength of Corruption
quests.description: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

quests.name: Precarious Predicament
quests.description: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody. You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

quests.name: Grark Lorkrub
quests.description: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress. When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

quests.name: The Heart of the Mountain
quests.description: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.description: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.description: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
quests.description: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.

quests.name: Boat Wreckage
quests.description: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

quests.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
quests.description: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.

quests.name: The Knife Revealed
quests.description: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Psychometric Reading
quests.description: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
quests.description: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
quests.description: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

quests.name: The Writhing Deep
quests.description: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
quests.description: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Muigin and Larion

quests.name: Haze of Evil
quests.description: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Larion and Muigin
quests.description: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Zapper Fuel
quests.description: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Marvon's Workshop
quests.description: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Recipe of the Kaldorei

quests.description: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.description: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.description: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: The True Masters

quests.name: The True Masters

quests.description: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The True Masters
quests.description: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task. You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

quests.name: Marshal Windsor
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor. You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

quests.name: Abandoned Hope
quests.description: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.description: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.description: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Chasing A-Me 01
quests.description: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Overmaster Pyron
quests.description: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig. You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

quests.name: Incendius!
quests.description: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

quests.name: A Crumpled Up Note
quests.description: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

quests.name: Freed from the Hive
quests.description: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive. Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

quests.name: A Hero's Welcome
quests.description: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.description: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: Thalanaar Delivery
quests.description: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

quests.name: A Shred of Hope
quests.description: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information. Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

quests.name: FIFTY! YEP!
quests.description: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Crystals of Power
quests.description: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: The Northern Pylon
quests.description: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Good Stuff
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.

quests.name: The Eastern Pylon
quests.description: Discover the location of the Eastern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Western Pylon
quests.description: Discover the location of the Western Crystal Pylon.

quests.name: The Apes of Un'Goro
quests.description: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
quests.description: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
quests.description: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
quests.description: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: A Sample of Slime...
quests.description: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
quests.description: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: Tablet of the Seven
quests.description: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Food for Baby
quests.description: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Becoming a Parent
quests.description: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Bone-Bladed Weapons
quests.description: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Mighty U'cha
quests.description: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Making Sense of It
quests.description: Speak with J.D. Collie in a moment.

quests.name: Jail Break!
quests.description: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

quests.name: Yuka Screwspigot
quests.description: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Kharan Mighthammer
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer. The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

quests.name: Kharan's Tale
quests.description: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

quests.name: The Bearer of Bad News
quests.description: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
quests.description: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Princess's Surprise
quests.description: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise
quests.description: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

quests.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
quests.description: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

quests.name: Felbound Ancients
quests.description: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

quests.name: Purified!
quests.description: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.

quests.name: Caught!
quests.description: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Ledger from Tanaris
quests.description: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Key to Freedom
quests.description: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

quests.name: The Tome of Nobility

quests.name: Lost!

quests.description: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Beware of Pterrordax
quests.description: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Volcanic Activity
quests.description: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

quests.name: Shizzle's Flyer
quests.description: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.

quests.name: Super Sticky
quests.description: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

quests.description: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: Corrupted Sabers
quests.description: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna. Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

quests.description: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned. Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.description: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.

quests.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
quests.description: Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge. If you have trouble finding them, perhaps try to get more clues from Laris.

quests.description: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Kayneth Stillwind

quests.name: The Sparklematic 5200!

quests.description: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.description: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

quests.name: Put Her Down
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.description: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.

quests.description: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
quests.description: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water. Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

quests.name: Wild Guardians
quests.description: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.description: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.description: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken. It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!

quests.name: Thundris Windweaver
quests.description: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

quests.name: The Cliffspring River
quests.description: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there. Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

quests.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
quests.description: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell. Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps. Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor. Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

quests.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
quests.description: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
quests.description: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.

quests.name: Mayara Brightwing
quests.description: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

quests.description: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

quests.description: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

quests.description: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.description: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
quests.description: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
quests.description: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.description: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
quests.description: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: The Completed Robe
quests.description: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

quests.name: The Ancient Egg
quests.description: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.description: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
quests.description: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.description: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.description: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: The Red Crystal
quests.description: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range. Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

quests.name: As Water Cascades
quests.description: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

quests.name: The Fragments Within
quests.description: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

quests.name: Alien Egg
quests.description: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

quests.name: You Scream, I Scream...
quests.description: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule's brand ice cream.

quests.name: Pacify the Centaur
quests.description: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Strange Sources
quests.description: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.description: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

quests.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.description: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

quests.name: Enraged Wildkin
quests.description: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of. Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

quests.name: Serpent Wild
quests.description: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

quests.name: Mother's Milk
quests.description: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
quests.description: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

quests.name: Assassination Plot
quests.description: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

quests.name: Guarding Secrets
quests.description: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

quests.name: Guarding Secrets
quests.description: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

quests.name: Guardians of the Altar
quests.description: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Wildkin of Elune
quests.description: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.description: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

quests.name: Free at Last
quests.description: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

quests.name: Further Corruption
quests.description: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

quests.name: Tinkee Steamboil
quests.description: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

quests.name: Lost in Battle
quests.description: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
quests.description: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

quests.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
quests.description: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: Shard of a Felhound
quests.description: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: Shard of an Infernal
quests.description: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.description: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

quests.name: Counting Out Time
quests.description: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Counting Out Time
quests.description: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
quests.description: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

quests.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
quests.description: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: Operative Bijou
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.description: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

quests.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
quests.description: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

quests.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
quests.description: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
quests.description: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
quests.description: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

quests.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
quests.description: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.description: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

quests.name: Message to Maxwell
quests.description: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.description: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.description: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

quests.name: Better Late Than Never
quests.description: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

quests.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
quests.description: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

quests.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
quests.description: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

quests.name: Good Natured Emma
quests.description: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

quests.name: The Jeremiah Blues
quests.description: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

quests.name: Good Luck Charm
quests.description: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

quests.name: Two Halves Become One
quests.description: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it. Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
quests.description: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

quests.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
quests.description: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

quests.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
quests.description: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

quests.name: Shy-Rotam
quests.description: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

quests.name: Aquatic Form
quests.description: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

quests.name: Sacred Fire
quests.description: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

quests.name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
quests.description: In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Grimtotem Spying
quests.description: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.description: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Leggings of Arcana
quests.description: In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Breastplate of Bloodthirst
quests.description: In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

quests.name: Maxwell's Mission
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

quests.name: Threat of the Winterfall
quests.description: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

quests.name: Winterfall Firewater
quests.description: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Falling to Corruption
quests.description: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

quests.name: Mystery Goo
quests.description: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.name: Toxic Horrors
quests.description: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Winterfall Runners
quests.description: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

quests.name: Arikara
quests.description: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Command
quests.description: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Clear the Way
quests.description: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill. Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
quests.description: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

quests.name: Scarlet Diversions
quests.description: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.description: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.description: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

quests.name: Hot Fiery Death
quests.description: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

quests.name: High Chief Winterfall
quests.description: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

quests.name: The Final Piece
quests.description: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
quests.description: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

quests.name: Lorax's Tale
quests.description: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained. You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
quests.description: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

quests.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara. Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Little Pamela
quests.description: Find Pamela Redpath.

quests.name: Tribal Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas. Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Elemental Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands. Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Elemental Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
quests.description: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Tribal Leatherworking
quests.description: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale. Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Pamela's Doll
quests.description: Find Pamela's doll.

quests.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
quests.description: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

quests.name: Auntie Marlene
quests.description: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

quests.name: A Strange Historian
quests.description: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

quests.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
quests.description: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
quests.description: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Verifying the Corruption
quests.description: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
quests.description: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
quests.description: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
quests.description: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
quests.description: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
quests.description: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

quests.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
quests.description: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

quests.name: Are We There, Yeti?
quests.description: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it: Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring) Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris) Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater) When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

quests.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
quests.description: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
quests.description: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
quests.description: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

quests.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
quests.description: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 5 Skin of Shadow.

quests.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
quests.description: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Villains of Darrowshire
quests.description: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Winterfall Intrusion
quests.description: Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
quests.description: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
quests.description: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
quests.description: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
quests.description: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Brother Carlin
quests.description: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
quests.description: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
quests.description: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

quests.name: The Active Agent
quests.description: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
quests.description: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.description: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
quests.description: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.description: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.description: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.description: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.description: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.description: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
quests.description: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.description: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.description: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
quests.description: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.description: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.description: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.description: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.description: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.description: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
quests.description: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to the Bulwark
quests.description: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Uncle Carlin
quests.description: Find Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: A Final Blow
quests.description: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.description: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

quests.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
quests.description: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

quests.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
quests.description: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.description: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.description: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Tormented By the Past
quests.description: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

quests.name: To Winterspring!
quests.description: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: Starfall
quests.description: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.description: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

quests.name: Remorseful Highborne
quests.description: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

quests.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
quests.description: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Eagan Peltskinner
quests.description: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
quests.description: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
quests.description: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

quests.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
quests.description: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

quests.name: The Argent Hold
quests.description: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.description: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.description: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

quests.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
quests.description: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

quests.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
quests.description: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

quests.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
quests.description: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

quests.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
quests.description: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

quests.name: Sweet Serenity
quests.description: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

quests.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
quests.description: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

quests.name: Corruption
quests.description: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

quests.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
quests.description: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.description: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Last Barov
quests.description: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov. Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.description: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Last Barov
quests.description: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov. Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

quests.name: Family Tree
quests.description: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

quests.name: Hand of Iruxos
quests.description: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.description: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.description: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
quests.description: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

quests.name: Catch of the Day
quests.description: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

quests.name: Lazy Peons
quests.description: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.description: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.description: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.description: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.description: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
quests.description: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.description: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: Gordo's Task
quests.description: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

quests.name: Doom Weed
quests.description: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

quests.name: Bone Collector
quests.description: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

quests.name: A Warden of the Horde
